payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute per-shelf max value for each possible number of taken items via prefix-suffix sums, then combine shelves using DP over total items (knapsack group DP).
payload.rationale: The solution uses a DP table that logically depends on shelf index and item count, typical of 2D DP. The per-shelf precomputation adds an inner dimension but overall structure matches dp_2d_state.
